## Scenarios

Time is the scenario's wall time on kind. Notes give a skip's reason or the checks that failed.

| Scenario | Area | Kind | Time (s) | Compose | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `basic-two-way` | basic | ✅ pass | 3.2 | ✅ pass | The far end calls in, the edge bridges to the backend, and audio flows both ways: the backend hears the caller's 600 Hz and the caller hears the backend's 1000 Hz. The caller hangs up. |
| `backend-hangup` | basic | ✅ pass | 2.7 | ✅ pass | The backend ends the call; the BYE reaches the far end. |
| `cancel` | basic | ✅ pass | 2.5 | ✅ pass | The far end gives up while the backend is ringing; the CANCEL reaches the backend. |
| `busy-fallback` | failures | ✅ pass | 3.6 | ✅ pass | The backend answers 486. The edge does not pass the failure back: it answers with the fallback, which in the bench is a 1400 Hz tone and an X-Fallback-Reason response header, then hangs up. |
| `decline-fallback` | failures | ✅ pass | 3.6 | ✅ pass | The backend declines with 603; the caller gets the fallback. |
| `no-answer-fallback` | failures | ✅ pass | 9.2 | ✅ pass | The backend rings past the edge's ring timeout (6 s in the bench); the caller gets the fallback. |
| `unreachable-fallback` | failures | ✅ pass | 9.0 | ✅ pass | The backend address doesn't respond at all (the edge routes user "unreachable" to a TEST-NET address); the caller gets the fallback once the ring timeout passes. |
| `header-passthrough` | headers | ✅ pass | 1.6 | ✅ pass | X- headers from the far end reach the backend unchanged. |
| `blind-transfer` | transfers | ✅ pass | 7.7 | ✅ pass | The backend asks for a blind transfer with a REFER. The edge ends the REFER itself (202, NOTIFY, releases the backend) and places the transfer to the runner's target, carrying the caller's X- headers. The caller hears the backend, then the target; the target hears the caller. |
| `dtmf-both-ways` | dtmf | ✅ pass | 5.2 | ✅ pass | RFC 2833 digits pass through the edge in both directions. |
| `codec-pcmu` | codecs | ✅ pass | 2.2 | ✅ pass | A far end offering only PCMU gets PCMU end to end. |
| `codec-pcma` | codecs | ✅ pass | 2.2 | ✅ pass | A far end offering only PCMA gets PCMA end to end. |
| `codec-g722` | codecs | ➖ skip |  | ➖ skip | A far end offering only G.722 gets G.722. Skipped unless the run declares codec:g722: the bench's FreeSWITCH image has no G.722 module and the runner has no G.722 codec yet.<br>*Kind: needs codec:g722*<br>*Compose: needs codec:g722* |
| `admission-limit` | admission | ➖ skip |  | ✅ pass | With the edge's session limit lowered to 4 (two bridged calls), a third concurrent call is refused with 503 and never reaches the backend. The limit is restored afterwards.<br>*Kind: needs esl* |
| `options` | health | ✅ pass | 0.5 | ✅ pass | The edge answers OPTIONS with 200 while it has capacity (what a SIP proxy's dispatcher probes). |
| `echo` | basic | ✅ pass | 3.2 | ✅ pass | The backend echoes the caller's audio; the caller hears its own 600 Hz back through the edge. |
